Folio optional offline translation pack: English to Hindi (Mozilla en-hi 1.0).
Mozilla registry release: tiny, Release. Source weights, vocabulary, and
lexical shortlist are MPL-2.0 (see ../LICENSE.txt). Links to upstream source
data and training pipeline:
https://github.com/mozilla/translations
https://storage.googleapis.com/moz-fx-translations-data--303e-prod-translations-data/db/models.json
https://firefox.settings.services.mozilla.com/v1/buckets/main/collections/translations-models/records

These files are gzip-compressed and the model is split for delivery; the
reassembled raw model and other original bytes are unchanged. Original
uncompressed binary URLs and SHA-256:
